A '''bardiche''' was a type of bladed polearm,<ref name="EGTWAC" /> a traditional weapon of the [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]].<ref name="EGTW" /> During the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan]], the [[Unidentified Brotherhood of Darkness member|member]] of the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] who captured [[Jedi Lord]] [[Berethon]] had a [[lanvarok]] with a bardiche blade.<ref name="EGTWAC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bardiche was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', a reference book written by [[Jason Fry]] and released in [[2012]].<ref name="EGTW" /> It was later expanded in the [[2014]] fifth entry in the ''[[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut]]'' series of posts by [[Jason Fry]] on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|blog]]. The article featured content cut from ''The Essential Guide to Warfare''.<ref name="EGTWAC" />
